name: Return to Kristoff
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron.  Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.
narrative.objectives: Return to Brother Kristoff in the Cathedral Square.  Give him the book The Stresses of Iron.
narrative.offerRewardText: That's the one! Thank you, adventurer. May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
narrative.requestItemsText: Were you able to find the book?

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 24, 4,105 XP in all.

quests.name: Speaking of Fortitude
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep and speak with Milton Sheaf.

quests.name: Brother Paxton
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Brother Paxton in the Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Ink Supplies
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire and ask him for Rethban Iron Ore.

quests.name: Rethban Ore
quests.objectiveText: Gather 5 loads of Rethban Ore and bring it to Brother Paxton in the Northshire Library.

quests.name: Return to Kristoff
quests.objectiveText: Return to Brother Kristoff in the Cathedral Square.
